W.name: Defensive Ball Curl
W.title: Template:Data Rammus/Defensive Ball Curl
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Defensive Ball Curl|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Rammus
|skill        = W
|icon         = Defensive Ball Curl.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rammus}} enters a defensive stance for a few seconds, gaining {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resist}}}}. During this time, enemies that land a basic attack against '''Rammus''' are dealt {{as|magic damage}}.
|blurb2       = ''Defensive Ball Curl'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterward.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Rammus''' ends ''Defensive Ball Curl''.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' enters a defensive stance for 7 seconds, gaining {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}. While active, enemies that use a basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} against '''Rammus''' are dealt {{as|15|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''total''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''total''' magic resistance)}} {{as|magic damage}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Armor|{{ap|27 to 47}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30 to 60}}% '''total''' armor)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Magic Resistance|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30 to 60}}% '''total''' magic resistance)}}}}
|description2 = ''Defensive Ball Curl'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically upon casting ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'' or ''{{ai|Soaring Slam|Rammus}}''.
|description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Rammus''' ends ''Defensive Ball Curl''. 
|cooldown     = 7
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = 40
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Auto
|cast time = none
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = False
|spelleffects = aoe
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
*The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
**Deactivating the ability manually does not.
* ''Defensive Ball Curl'' ends immediately if {{ai|Powerball|Rammus}} is cast.
* ''Defensive Ball Curl'' will return damage from attacks and/or abilities that apply [[on-hit effect]]s ({{ai|Mystic Shot|Ezreal}}) as well as from {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} (will not return damage from [[turret]]s, {{ai|H-28G Evolution Turret|Heimerdinger}}, or {{ai|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}).
* The resistance scaling will factor from all sources, including ''Defensive Ball Curl's'' flat bonus. This will recalculate over the duration.
}}

|skill        = R
|icon         = Soaring Slam.png

|blurb2      = ''Soaring Slam'' gains increased {{sti|range}} based on '''Rammus'''' {{sti|movement speed}}. '''Rammus''' can cast this ability during ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'', which will additionally {{tip|airborne|knock up}} enemies in the epicenter.
|blurb3      = ''Soaring Slam's'' damage affects {{tip|structures}} and is doubled against {{tip|turrets}}.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|{{tip|Cc-immunity|nolink=true}}}}: {{tip|Crowd control}} cannot be applied during this time.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location with {{tip|Cc-immunity|immunity to crowd control}}. Upon arrival, he creates an impact that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
|description2 = If ''Soaring Slam'' was cast during ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'', enemies within the epicenter of the impact are also {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds and are dealt ''{{ais|Powerball|Rammus}}'' damage. ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'' will not collide with enemies during the dash, and its channel will be maintained for the dash and end afterwards.
|description3 = The impact causes 3 aftershocks to burst from the area over {{fd|3.5}} seconds, each one applying and refreshing the duration of the initial {{tip|slow}}.
|description4 = ''Soaring Slam's'' damage affects {{tip|structures}} and is doubled against {{tip|turrets}}.
